description: Custom React hook for user registration, managing form state, validation, and API interactions in a registration screen.

methods.name: validateCredentials
methods.description: Validates user input fields for registration, setting error messages accordingly.

methods.name: registerAction
methods.description: Initiates registration process by validating credentials and checking phone existence.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Callback for successful phone existence check, navigates to OTP screen if phone does not exist.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during phone existence check, displaying error messages.
